programmes.amount_note: Amount depends on rent (capped), household size, location (zone) and income over the last 12 months

procedure_steps.detail: Simulate your entitlement on caf.fr
Create or log in to your CAF account and file the housing-aid application online
Upload the rent certificate (attestation de loyer) signed by your landlord and your bank details (RIB)

documents_required.doc: Rental agreement (bail) or attestation de loyer
Valid residence permit for non-EU nationals

eligibility.income_note: Means-tested on the last 12 months' income. Published annual resource ceiling for the MAXIMUM APL (2025): EUR 5,235 single, EUR 7,501 couple, EUR 8,947 with 1 dependant, +EUR 346 per extra dependant. Above these ceilings the aid tapers rather than stops (eligibility ends around ~1 net SMIC for a single tenant depending on rent/zone).

programmes.source_snippet: L'aide personnalisée au logement (APL) permet de réduire le montant de votre loyer ou redevance si vous êtes locataire ou résident en établissement.

programmes.amount_note: Amount depends on rent, household and income; applies to non-conventionné housing not eligible for APL

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online in your CAF account (aide au logement section)
Provide the rent certificate and proof of income

eligibility.income_note: Same official resource ceilings as APL for the maximum rate (2025): EUR 5,235/year single, EUR 7,501 couple, +EUR 346 per dependant; aid decreases progressively above.

programmes.source_snippet: The ALS is the housing allowance paid when the dwelling is not conventionné (not APL-eligible), under household income conditions.

programmes.amount_note: Amount depends on rent, family size and income; reserved for family situations (married less than 5 years, or with dependants)

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online in your CAF account (aide au logement section)
Provide the rent certificate, family booklet (livret de famille) and income details

eligibility.income_note: Same official resource ceilings as APL for the maximum rate (2025): EUR 5,235/year single, EUR 7,501 couple, +EUR 346 per dependant; aid tapers above these thresholds.

programmes.source_snippet: The ALF helps households with family responsibilities (dependants or recently married couples) pay their rent in non-conventionné housing.

programmes.amount_note: One-off or short-term aid for deposit, first bills, rent arrears or energy debts; amounts set by each département

procedure_steps.detail: Contact your CAF, CCAS or Conseil départemental housing desk
File the FSL dossier with proof of situation (rent notice, debts, income)
A social worker assesses the file and the departmental commission decides

documents_required.doc: Proof of housing situation (bail, quittances, debt notice)

eligibility.income_note: Means-tested; no national ceiling - each departement sets its rule in its reglement interieur. E.g. Metropole de Lyon: quotient familial <= EUR 860/month, i.e. ~EUR 10,320/year for a single person (QF x12); other departements often use ~1.5x RSA. Conversion QF monthly per part x 12 documented.

programmes.source_snippet: The FSL, financed by the départements, grants aid for moving in (deposit, first rent) and for staying housed (rent or energy arrears).

programmes.amount_note: Free guarantee covering up to 36 months of unpaid rent and charges (advance recovered from the tenant); rent caps apply (higher in Île-de-France)

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility and request a 'visa' on visale.fr
Give the certified visa number to the landlord before signing the lease
The landlord activates the guarantee online before the lease is signed

eligibility.income_note: Since 6 January 2026 the salarié route (private-sector employee aged 31+) requires net monthly salary of €1,710 or less (€20,520/yr), up from €1,500. Applicants under 31, bail mobilité tenants, employees in professional mobility and Cohabilis intergenerational tenants have NO income ceiling; separate rent ceilings apply (€1,940 Île-de-France, €1,575 large urban areas/Corsica/DROM, €1,365 elsewhere).

programmes.source_snippet: La garantie Visale est la caution gratuite d'Action Logement : elle couvre les loyers et charges impayés du locataire.

programmes.amount_note: Interest-free loan covering the security deposit (dépôt de garantie), repayable in instalments (ceiling published by Action Logement, historically up to 1 200 €)

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on actionlogement.fr with your lease and deposit amount
Action Logement pays the advance to the landlord; you repay monthly at 0 %

documents_required.doc: Proof of employment situation (under-30 or private-sector employee)

eligibility.income_note: Mainly under-30s (students, young workers) and private-sector employees; conditions updated on actionlogement.fr

programmes.source_snippet: Action Logement lends the security deposit interest-free to eligible tenants moving into the private rental stock.

programmes.amount_note: Grant and/or interest-free loan toward search costs, rent or deposit when moving for a job (new hire, transfer, training); amounts depend on the scheme variant

procedure_steps.detail: Check the scheme for your situation (salarie in mobility) on actionlogement.fr
File the request with the employment contract or mobility proof and the new lease

documents_required.doc: Work contract or employer mobility attestation

eligibility.income_note: Employees of private-sector companies (10+ employees) moving for professional reasons

programmes.source_snippet: Action Logement subsidises the housing costs of private-sector employees who relocate for work (search aid, rent support, deposit loan).

programmes.amount_note: State-subsidised rooms and studios; rents far below market (varies by city and comfort level); priority to social-criteria grant holders
programmes.deadline_note: Annual application window via the Dossier Social Étudiant (DSE), typically March–May; later allocations from waiting lists

procedure_steps.detail: File the DSE on messervices.etudiant.gouv.fr during the annual window
Indicate residence wishes; CROUS allocates rooms by social criteria and distance
Accept the offer and pay the reservation fee / first rent

eligibility.income_note: Students enrolled in higher education; priority by social criteria (grant level, distance from home)

programmes.source_snippet: CROUS residences offer students subsidised accommodation allocated on social criteria via the annual Dossier Social Étudiant.

programmes.amount_note: Forfait amount for a single person without resources from 1 April 2025 (646,52 €/month); reduced by any resources and by the housing forfait; higher amounts for couples/children

File the RSA application online (or via Cerfa form at the CAF)
Declare resources quarterly and meet the integration/activity commitments

programmes.source_snippet: Le montant forfaitaire du RSA pour une personne seule sans enfant passera à 646,52 € (au 1er avril 2025).

programmes.amount_note: Maximum 1 041,59 €/month from 1 April 2026 for a person without resources; differential (tops up other income); annual resource ceiling 12 499 € for a single person (deconjugalised since 2023)

eligibility.income_note: 2025: EUR 12,399.84/year single (12 x EUR 1,033.32 max); +EUR 6,199.92 per child; spouse's income no longer counted since Oct 2023 (deconjugalisation).

programmes.name_local: Allocation de solidarité aux personnes âgées (ASPA)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum 1 043,59 €/month for a single person and 1 620,18 € for a couple (2026); differential allowance topping up resources; recoverable on estate above a threshold

Provide resources of the last 3 months and property details
The fund assesses and pays the top-up monthly

eligibility.income_note: 2026: annual resource ceiling EUR 12,523.14 single / EUR 19,442.21 couple (Jan 2026); differential benefit up to that level.

programmes.source_snippet: En 2026, le montant mensuel maximum de l'ASPA est de 1 043,59 euros pour une personne seule et 1 620,18 euros pour un couple.

programmes.amount_note: Differential allowance topping up a disability pension below the minimum level; same maximum amounts as ASPA but for people below retirement age; recoverable on estate

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via your pension fund paying the disability pension
Provide resources and pension details; the fund computes the top-up

eligibility.income_note: Monthly resource ceiling EUR 914.85 single (April 2025) => EUR 10,978/year; couple EUR 1,601/month => EUR 19,212/year.

programmes.source_snippet: The ASI guarantees a minimum resource level to people receiving a disability pension and not yet entitled to the ASPA.

programmes.amount_note: Daily allowance paid per month after exhaustion of ARE rights; amount revalued periodically (about 19 €/day in 2025); renewable every 6 months under conditions

Provide proof of at least 5 years of salaried activity in the last 10 years and of resources
Renew every 6 months while actively seeking work

programmes.source_snippet: The ASS is paid to jobseekers with a substantial work history whose unemployment insurance rights are exhausted, under a resource ceiling.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact your local Mission locale for an assessment interview
Sign the mutual commitment contract and follow the integration programme
Receive the monthly allowance subject to attendance and effort

eligibility.income_note: The young person's own monthly resources must be below the RSA forfait (EUR 646.52/month in 2025 => EUR 7,758/year); allowance up to ~EUR 497.75/month depending on resources.

programmes.source_snippet: La Garantie jeunes combines a monthly allowance with an intensive personalised pathway for NEET young people in hardship.

procedure_steps.detail: Check resources (tax notice N-1) against the ceiling
File the AJ application online or at the Bureau d'aide juridictionnelle of the tribunal
The bureau grants full or partial aid and designates or validates your lawyer

eligibility.income_note: Resource (RFR) and wealth ceilings; action not manifestly unfounded; certain situations give aid without a resource test (minors, victims of specific offences...)

Otherwise create a CAF account and declare the children (livret de famille / birth certificates)

programmes.source_snippet: En 2026, le montant de base s'élève à 152,25 € par mois pour deux enfants et atteint 347,32 € pour trois enfants.

programmes.amount_note: Monthly supplement (standard amount ~200 €, increased ~300 € for the lowest incomes, revalued annually) for families with 3+ children aged 3-20 under an income ceiling

programmes.amount_note: Fixed monthly amount per orphan child or child whose parent does not pay maintenance (revalued annually; about 200 €/month); no income condition

programmes.source_snippet: The ASF supports people raising a child deprived of one or both parents' support, without income condition.

Non-recipients: create a CAF account and apply before the school year

programmes.name_local: Prime à la naissance / à l'adoption (Paje)

The grant is paid automatically around the 7th month if resources qualify

programmes.name_local: Complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG)

Apply for the CMG with the CAF; declare salary monthly on Pajemploi

programmes.amount_note: Monthly benefit during parental leave after a birth/adoption (full rate about 400 €, partial rates if working part-time; increased rate for single parents), duration depends on birth rank

Choose full or partial rate; the other parent can share the entitlement period

eligibility.income_note: Parent of a child under 3 (birth rank rules for duration); must stop or reduce professional activity; minimum prior social-security affiliation

programmes.source_snippet: The PreParE compensates a parent who stops or reduces work to raise a young child, shareable between both parents.

programmes.amount_note: Base amount about 150 €/month plus supplements in 6 categories according to the level of expense/support needed; up to age 20

CDAPH assesses the disability rate (>= 80 %, or 50-79 % for some supplements)
CAF pays the allowance and any supplement monthly

Receive AJPP per day of absence, within the 310-day envelope

A medico-social team assesses dependency (GIR grid 1-4)

eligibility.income_note: Aged 60+ with loss of autonomy (GIR 1-4); resident in France; contribution scaled to income

programmes.source_snippet: C'est le support numérique de l'ensemble des aides de la Région en faveur des lycéens et lycéennes d'Occitanie.

programmes.name_local: Aide régionale au permis de conduire (Bretagne)
programmes.name_en: Brittany Region driving-licence grant for young people in insertion
programmes.amount_note: Up to EUR 1,500 for code + permis B (EUR 1,300 for permis B alone), paid to the driving school, for 18-25 year-olds followed by a Mission locale in a PREPA/QUALIF qualifying path

procedure_steps.detail: Build the project with your Mission locale adviser, who files the application with the Region

eligibility.income_note: Not income-tested as such: reserved to young people followed by a Mission locale in a regional qualifying scheme (PREPA to QUALIF) whose lack of a licence blocks their professional project

programmes.source_snippet: Aide régionale pouvant atteindre 1 500 EUR pour financer le code et le permis B des jeunes de 18 à 25 ans suivis par une Mission locale.

programmes.amount_note: Regional aid of up to ~EUR 1,200 toward the permis B for lycéens, apprentices, jobseekers under 30, single parents and young people in a Contrat d'engagement jeune

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the Region's online service before starting the driving-school training

eligibility.income_note: Status-based (lycéens, apprentis, jobseekers <30, single parents, CEJ); income conditions may apply per profile

programmes.source_snippet: La Région Hauts-de-France aide au financement du permis de conduire B des jeunes et publics en insertion (jusqu'à environ 1 200 EUR).

programmes.amount_note: Annual grant in 3 echelons (EUR 120 / EUR 336 / EUR 525 in 2026-27), paid in 3 termly instalments; EUR 327/year internat bonus
programmes.deadline_note: Application between 1 September and mid-October via the collège or EduConnect

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online via EduConnect/Scolarité-Services or with the paper form at the collège, September to mid-October
The académie service computes the echelon from the household RFR and number of children

eligibility.income_note: 2026-27 (RFR 2025, avis 2026): echelon 1 ceiling EUR 18,488 for 1 child, +~EUR 4,266 per child, EUR 48,352 for 8+ children (barème Éducation nationale / service-public).

programmes.source_snippet: La bourse de collège est attribuée sous conditions de ressources, selon le revenu fiscal de référence et le nombre d'enfants à charge (3 échelons, versée trimestriellement).

programmes.amount_note: Annual grant in 6 echelons (EUR 495 to EUR 1,053 in 2026-27), paid termly; internat bonus EUR 327-672 and EUR 341.71 equipment bonus in 1st year of vocational tracks
programmes.deadline_note: Application from 1 September to mid-October via the téléservice bourses

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online on the bourses téléservice or at the lycée between September and mid-October

eligibility.income_note: 2026-27 (RFR 2025, avis 2026): ceiling for the lowest (1st) echelon EUR 21,611 with 1 child, rising to EUR 49,870 with 8+ children (service-public F616).

programmes.source_snippet: La bourse comporte 6 échelons, qui prennent en compte le nombre d'enfants à charge composant votre foyer et les ressources de ce foyer à ne pas dépasser.

programmes.amount_note: Health-insurance coverage of medical costs for anyone working or residing in France in a stable and regular way, regardless of income or employment

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

eligibility.income_note: No income condition: coverage based on professional activity or stable residence

programmes.source_snippet: La protection universelle maladie (PUMA) garantit une prise en charge des frais de santé à toute personne travaillant ou résidant en France de manière stable et régulière.

programmes.name_en: State medical aid for undocumented foreign residents
programmes.amount_note: Coverage of medical and hospital costs for foreign nationals in an irregular situation, resident in France for more than 3 months, with modest resources

procedure_steps.detail: File the AME application (form S1106) at your CPAM with proof of identity, address and resources

documents_required.doc: Proof of 3 months' residence in France

eligibility.income_note: Resources must be below the free-C2S ceiling: EUR 10,421/year single (metropole, April 2026), higher per additional household member.

programmes.source_snippet: L'aide médicale de l'État (AME) permet aux étrangers en situation irrégulière, résidant en France depuis plus de 3 mois, d'accéder aux soins sous conditions de ressources.

programmes.amount_note: Covers 50% or 70% of adaptation works (walk-in shower, stairlift, grab bars...) within a EUR 22,000 works ceiling, for owner-occupiers aged 70+ (60+ with loss of autonomy) or with a disability rate >=50%/PCH

procedure_steps.detail: Contact a France Rénov' adviser and get an AMO (assistant) for the autonomie diagnostic
File the application with quotes BEFORE starting works
Have works done by a professional and send invoices to trigger payment

eligibility.income_note: 2026 Anah grid: 'modestes' ceiling EUR 22,259/year (1 person, province) or EUR 29,253 (Ile-de-France); 'tres modestes' EUR 17,363 / EUR 24,031; +EUR 5,151-8,663 per extra household member.

programmes.source_snippet: MaPrimeAdapt' finance 50 % ou 70 % du coût des travaux d'adaptation du logement, dans la limite d'un plafond de 22 000 EUR, selon les ressources.

programmes.amount_note: Regulated mortgage at a capped rate with reduced notary fees, for buying/building a main home or works over EUR 4,000; combinable with the PTZ

procedure_steps.detail: Check your commune's zone (A, B1, B2, C) and the resource ceiling for your household size
Apply through a bank that signed a convention with the State

documents_required.doc: Avis d'imposition N-2 (revenu fiscal de référence)

eligibility.income_note: Resource ceilings by zone and household size (RFR N-2): 1 person EUR 49,000 (zone A) to EUR 28,500 (zone C); 2 persons EUR 73,500 / EUR 42,750; 4 persons EUR 102,900 / EUR 59,850 (Anil, barème 2025).

programmes.source_snippet: Le Prêt d'accession sociale (PAS) à la propriété est un prêt accordé sous conditions de ressources. Il offre un taux d'intérêt avantageux.

programmes.name_en: Adie professional microcredit for business creators
programmes.funder: Adie (Association pour le droit à l'initiative économique)
programmes.amount_note: Microloan up to EUR 15,000 over 6-48 months plus a possible EUR 3,000 zero-interest 'apport en capital' advance; mandatory coaching; targets people excluded from classic bank credit

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the Adie online or in one of its local offices to discuss the project
Prepare the file with a counsellor (business plan, budget, guarantee)

eligibility.income_note: Adie's own fiche pratique (2026) publishes no income ceiling for the professional microcredit — it states only that financing of up to €15,000 is available to entrepreneurs excluded from ordinary bank credit.

programmes.source_snippet: Le montant maximum pour un prêt de l'Adie est de 15 000 EUR.

programmes.amount_note: Free pre-hire training (max 400 hours) to close a skills gap identified by an employer who commits to hire (CDI, CDD >= 6 months, alternance); trainee keeps AREF (min EUR 22.99/day) or may get RFPE if not indemnified; employer gets EUR 5/hour aid

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for a job offer mentioning 'Préparation opérationnelle à l'emploi' or ask your France Travail adviser
France Travail validates the POEI and a tripartite convention is signed before the hire

eligibility.income_note: Not household means-tested: open to registered jobseekers, indemnified or not

programmes.source_snippet: La POEI permet au demandeur d'emploi de bénéficier d'une formation (400 heures maximum) avant son embauche, avec le statut de stagiaire et une indemnisation.

programmes.name_en: France Travail mobility aid (travel, meals, accommodation)
programmes.amount_note: Reimbursement of costs for a job interview, training, exam or job start more than 60 km or 2h round-trip from home: EUR 0.23/km, EUR 6.25/day meals, EUR 31.20/night accommodation; capped at EUR 5,200 per year; SNCF travel vouchers possible

procedure_steps.detail: File the request on your France Travail online space BEFORE the trip (or within 7 days after an interview)
Send receipts within the deadline; reimbursement by bank transfer

documents_required.doc: Interview invitation / training or hiring proof

eligibility.income_note: Not household means-tested: for registered jobseekers, non-indemnified or with an ARE at or below the minimum; annual cap EUR 5,200

programmes.source_snippet: Vous pouvez bénéficier de l'aide à la mobilité, toutes catégories confondues, dans la limite d'un plafond annuel de 5 200 EUR.

programmes.amount_note: Funding of all or part of training fees for a jobseeker's retraining project validated by the France Travail counsellor; combinable with CPF for the remaining costs

procedure_steps.detail: Discuss the training project with your France Travail counsellor who validates its coherence
The AIF request is filed with the counsellor before the training starts

eligibility.income_note: Not household means-tested: subject to a training project validated by France Travail

programmes.source_snippet: L'AIF finance tout ou partie des frais pédagogiques d'une formation validée par le conseiller France Travail dans le cadre du projet professionnel du demandeur d'emploi.

programmes.name_local: Aide à la garde d'enfants pour parent isolé (AGEPI)
programmes.name_en: France Travail childcare aid for single parents returning to work (AGEPI)
programmes.amount_note: One-off aid toward childcare for children under 10 when a single parent resumes a job or training: ~EUR 170 (<15h/week) to ~EUR 400 (1 child, 15-35h) and up to ~EUR 561 (3+ children full-time)

procedure_steps.detail: Ask your France Travail counsellor within one month of resuming the job or starting the training

eligibility.income_note: For non-indemnified jobseekers or those with a daily allowance below ~EUR 30.42 raising children under 10 alone

programmes.source_snippet: L'AGEPI aide les parents isolés demandeurs d'emploi à financer la garde de leurs enfants de moins de 10 ans lors d'une reprise d'activité ou d'une entrée en formation.

programmes.amount_note: Monthly pension for insured people whose working or earning capacity is reduced by at least two-thirds after an illness or non-work accident: 30%, 40% or 50% of the average of the 10 best years' salary depending on category; requires minimum contribution/employment history

procedure_steps.detail: File the invalidity pension request with your CPAM (form S4150) with medical evidence

eligibility.income_note: Not household means-tested: based on incapacity rate and prior salary/contributions

programmes.source_snippet: La pension d'invalidité compense la perte de salaire due à une réduction d'au moins deux tiers de la capacité de travail ou de gain.

programmes.name_local: Exonération de taxe foncière des seniors modestes
programmes.amount_note: Full exemption from taxe foncière on the main home for people aged 75+ (or ASPA/ASI/AAH recipients at any eligible age) below the RFR ceiling; 65-74 year-olds below the ceiling get a EUR 100 relief; automatic with the income-tax declaration

procedure_steps.detail: No separate claim: the exemption is applied from your income-tax data if conditions are met; otherwise claim to the tax office

eligibility.income_note: Full exemption at 75+: RFR <= EUR 12,818 for 1 part (increased per additional half-part); 65-74: EUR 100 abattement under the same ceiling (impots.gouv.fr).

programmes.source_snippet: Les personnes de 75 ans ou plus dont le revenu fiscal de référence ne dépasse pas le plafond (environ 12 818 EUR pour 1 part) sont exonérées de taxe foncière sur leur résidence principale.

programmes.name_local: Pass Seniors (Ville de Paris) — Navigo gratuit
programmes.name_en: Paris Pass Seniors: free Navigo for low-income seniors
programmes.amount_note: Free Navigo travel (all zones) for Parisians aged 65+ (60+ if unfit for work), resident in Paris for at least 3 years, below the income ceiling and not liable for IFI

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the Paris.fr teleservice or at a mairie d'arrondissement with proof of age, 3-year residence and income

documents_required.doc: Proof of 3 years' residence in Paris

eligibility.income_note: RFR <= EUR 2,276/month, i.e. ~EUR 27,312/year for 1 part (2025 ceiling); not liable for IFI.

programmes.source_snippet: Le Pass Seniors permet aux Parisiens de 65 ans et plus aux revenus modestes (RFR plafonné) de voyager gratuitement sur le réseau francilien.

programmes.name_en: Bordeaux Metropolis water cheque for low-income households
programmes.amount_note: Automatic EUR 10-25 annual reduction on the drinking-water bill for low-income households of the metropolis (tarif social applied without request since January 2024 via a convention with the CAF de la Gironde)

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

eligibility.income_note: Social tariff for households at around RSA level (metropole: eligibility from ~90% of the RSA; RSA single EUR 646.52/month => EUR 7,758/year in 2025).

programmes.source_snippet: Depuis le 1er janvier 2024, le tarif social via le chèque eau est accordé automatiquement, en fonction du revenu ; le chèque est compris entre 10 et 25 euros par an.

programmes.name_en: CAF sport coupon for club membership
programmes.amount_note: Nominative coupons of EUR 10-20 toward a sports-club membership, licence or single sessions; some CAFs give larger sport aids for children of low-QF families

procedure_steps.detail: Check your CAF départementale's offer in your caf.fr account

documents_required.doc: CAF beneficiary number and QF attestation

eligibility.income_note: Quotient familial condition set by each CAF (e.g. QF <= ~EUR 765/month for the Ain scheme, i.e. ~EUR 9,180/year per part; QF monthly x12 conversion).

programmes.source_snippet: D'une valeur faciale de 10 ou 20 euros, le coupon sport est émis par la CAF sous conditions de ressources.

programmes.name_local: Aide personnalisée de retour à l'emploi (APRE)
programmes.amount_note: Départemental financial aid to remove barriers when returning to work or training: vehicle purchase/repair, driving licence, childcare, work equipment; amount and rules set by each département, requested via a social worker

procedure_steps.detail: Meet a social worker (CCAS, département, Mission locale) who builds and files the APRE request

documents_required.doc: Project evidence (job offer, training enrolment, quote)

eligibility.income_note: Means-tested; ceilings set by each département, typically around the RSA level (RSA single EUR 646.52/month => EUR 7,758/year in 2025).

programmes.source_snippet: L'APRE est une aide financière départementale destinée à lever les freins (mobilité, garde d'enfants, équipement) au retour à l'emploi ou en formation.

programmes.name_en: Youth aid fund for 16-25 year-olds in difficulty
programmes.amount_note: Individual or collective financial aid for young people aged 16-25 (up to 29 in some départements) facing hardship: housing, health, mobility, training, food; requested via a Mission locale or social worker

procedure_steps.detail: Contact your Mission locale or the département's social services to file an FAJ request

eligibility.income_note: For young people in social and financial hardship, typically with resources below the RSA level (EUR 646.52/month => EUR 7,758/year in 2025); rules set locally.

programmes.source_snippet: Le Fonds d'aide aux jeunes finance des aides individuelles ou collectives pour les 16-25 ans en difficulté, via les missions locales et les départements.

programmes.name_local: Aide de fin de droit (AFD) — France Travail
programmes.amount_note: One-off lump sum of EUR 355.86 (since 1 July 2025) paid automatically to jobseekers reaching the end of their ARE rights who do not meet the ASS activity condition (5 years in the last 10)

procedure_steps.detail: No application: paid automatically at the end of rights if eligible (not if the ASS refusal is due to excess resources)

eligibility.income_note: Not income-tested; excluded if the ASS refusal is due to resources above the ASS ceiling

programmes.source_snippet: L'aide de fin de droit (AFD), d'un montant de 355,86 EUR, est attribuée automatiquement depuis la réforme du chômage 2025 aux demandeurs d'emploi en fin de droits non éligibles à l'ASS.

programmes.name_en: Bordeaux Metropolis income-based solidarity transport fares
programmes.amount_note: TBM fares indexed on the household quotient familial since September 2021: free if QF < EUR 550/month, -50% between EUR 550 and 610, -30% between EUR 610 and 942; all household members benefit

procedure_steps.detail: Compute your rights on the TBM solidarity platform with your CAF quotient familial
Apply online with the CAF attestation to load the reduced fare on your TBM card

eligibility.income_note: QF is monthly per part: a 2-part household with QF EUR 942/month ≈ EUR 22,608/year (QF x12 x parts); free travel below QF EUR 550/month.

programmes.source_snippet: Si le quotient familial est inférieur à 550 EUR/mois, la réduction tarifaire est de 100 % ; entre 550 et 610, -50 % ; entre 610 et 942, -30 %.
